rulesTestNames: lets current managers get contact, application and attendance report views by id
owner: Host read model projector: hostReadModels contact detail view triggers
read: current organizer managers get by id while their account is not deleted; a view not written yet reads as missing
write: server only; written from the contact, its trait row, its event edges, the linked verified account's Catch payments, event titles and the merge receipts that name it as survivor, deleted when the contact is deleted, hidden or merged
migrationNotes: traits, revenue, events, eventsTruncated and activeMerges equal what getOrganizerContactDetail returns; activeMerges is absent on views written before it, which the client reads as no merges until the next write. The host-contact-detail-views copy-forward migration creates views for contacts shown before the triggers.

The view holds no linked account id, identity evidence, endpoint or payment id; the Host person page reads the name, tags and revision from hostContactSummaries and the newest note from organizerContactNotes.
